settings.title: Settings
settings.introMobile: On phone, use a LAN or public OpenAI-compatible API (127.0.0.1 / localhost points at the phone itself). Example: http://192.168.1.8:1234/v1 or https://api.example.com/v1. LAN HTTP is only for trusted networks.
settings.introDesktop: Connect to LM Studio Local Server (default http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1). Writing / analysis / embedding use separate slots.
settings.updateHint: After you confirm, the installer downloads to a temp folder and the new app launches.
settings.githubFallback: If in-app download cannot reach GitHub, open the Release page in a browser, or open: {url}
settings.pageSize: Analytics page size (works / chapters / logs, default 10)
settings.preview: Preview: Nana writing under the rain shelter — The quick brown fox 0123456789
settings.needProjectRag: Open a work before rebuilding the index
settings.presetHintCache: Disk context cache is on by default; a hit costs about 1/30 of a miss. For continue-writing, put stable settings first and changing instructions last to raise hit rate.
settings.presetHintHours: . Off-peak is half of peak. Peak: Beijing time weekdays 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00.
settings.notDeepseek: Not using DeepSeek; prices left unchanged
settings.refreshedPrices: Refreshed official DeepSeek prices for the {period} window
settings.apiKeyPhSaved: Saved; type again to replace (cannot view)
settings.apiKeyHintSaved: A key is already stored. This box never shows it; typing a new one overwrites it.
settings.apiKeyHintNew: Saved automatically. The UI cannot show the plaintext again.
settings.modelPh: Pick from the list below or type
settings.analysisModel: Analysis model (summary / consistency; empty falls back to writing model)
settings.embeddingModel: Embedding model (RAG; empty uses keyword recall only)
settings.imageIntro: Separate from the writing API. OpenAI-compatible: POST {base}/images/generations. Local Comfy later.
settings.targetChars: Target length (minimum per chapter; overshoot allowed)
settings.writingProModel: writing_pro_model (strong model for long continues, e.g. deepseek-v4-pro)
settings.writingProPh: Empty: infer pro from DeepSeek flash
settings.modelFallback: writing_model_fallback (fall back to default writing model if the chosen one fails)
settings.routePro: writing_route_pro_on_continue (use the strong model for continue)
settings.autoDigest: writing_auto_digest (after write, extract block memory for the next continue)
settings.autoCast: writing_auto_cast (after write, add new characters to this work; on by default)
settings.autoStorySync: writing_auto_story_sync (after write, sync storyline / timeline / relations / Canon; on by default; old drafts can rebuild from text on the Story bible page)
settings.stripRhetoric: writing_strip_rhetoric (strip “not A but B” rhetoric ticks on finalize; on by default)
settings.skipDeleteConfirm: skip_delete_confirm (delete without confirm; on by default; turn off to prompt)
settings.cacheFriendly: writing_cache_friendly_prompt (put changing continue-prompt fields last for DeepSeek prefix cache)
settings.disableThinking: disable_thinking (recommended for SenseNova / DeepSeek reasoning models so content is not empty)
settings.pickHint: Click a model to fill the {slot} slot
settings.peakNotice: DeepSeek peak hours now (weekdays 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing time). API prices are 2× off-peak; large batches are cheaper at night or on weekends

chat.title: Chat
chat.intro: Standalone chat; does not write chapters. Work context includes title, outline, and character names. Turn on “Attach chapter text” when you need the body.
chat.personaHint: Work chat and free chat each keep a persona. New session clears messages only.
chat.name: Name
chat.stylePh: e.g. brief, conclusion first, little small talk
chat.rolePh: Identity, tone, taboos, how to address the user
chat.freeOnly: Without an open work you can only free-chat.
chat.empty: No messages yet. Type below and press Enter.
chat.needNovel: Work chat needs a novel opened from Works
chat.sessionLoading: Session still loading; save persona in a moment
chat.needOpen: Work chat needs an open work

writingSys.novel: You are a novel-writing assistant. Reply in English. Discuss, suggest, and analyze. Do not output chapter patches meant to be saved, and do not pretend you already changed the manuscript.
writingSys.free: You are a general assistant. Reply in English. This is not the writing engine: do not change the user's project files, and do not output chapter JSON for disk.
writingSys.callName: Your name is “{name}”. Refer to yourself with that name.
writingSys.continueAtCursor: Continue a short passage at the cursor
writingSys.polishDefault: Cut “not A but B” contrasts, keep the plot, and raise visual detail
writingSys.rewriteDefault: Keep characters and voice, advance the same plot, and do not recap earlier text

story.title: Story bible
story.rebuildHint: Re-extract plot, timeline, relations, and unlocked Canon from existing chapter text. Does not rewrite prose.
story.mapHint: The map includes outline, characters, plot, timeline, Canon, and relations. For older drafts, use “Rebuild bible from text” above. Add or remove characters on the right; edit in the tabs below.

story.rebuildConfirm: This rebuilds plot, timeline, relations, and unlocked Canon from existing chapter text. Locked Canon is kept. Chapter prose, chapter focus, and beats are not rewritten. Unlocked bible data is cleared first, then AI runs per chapter — it may take a while and use quota.

draft.reading: Generation done. Reading… will auto-write after you stop scrolling
draft.deleted: Generated block deleted (memory cleared, not saved)
draft.instrRewriteHeader: [Task: full same-slot rewrite] Do not refer to, rewrite, expand, or imitate existing prose/old variants. Rewrite this section from scratch using only this block's creative instruction.
draft.instrNoContinue: Do not continue into later scenes or advance to the next beat. Do not polish the old draft as a base.
draft.instrLength: Meet or exceed the target length. Do not write shorter than the goal.
draft.instrUseOnly: Source: use only the “block creative instruction” below. Do not read, recap, or reuse any existing prose, old variants, or the previous-section digest.
draft.instrOwn:
Block creative instruction (follow strictly; rewrite from scratch):
{base}
draft.instrFromDigest: This block has no independent instruction: write a new section from scratch at the same story position using the “previous-section digest”. Keep characters and style; details may differ. Still do not continue into the next scene.
draft.instrBlank: This block has no instruction and no previous digest: write a new version from scratch at the same position. Keep characters and style; details and direction may differ. Do not continue into the next scene.
draft.needRewrite: Cannot rewrite: missing work or chapter
draft.maxJobs: At most {n} generations at once. Wait for one to finish or cancel.
draft.needVariant: Cannot generate a variant: missing work or chapter
draft.maxJobsCur: At most {n} lanes (already {cur}). Wait for one to finish or cancel.
draft.needFork: Cannot fork: missing work or chapter
draft.forkInstr: Fork from here: continue from the text above and write the next stretch that can run parallel to the main line. Do not repeat sentences already written.
draft.needPolish: Cannot polish: missing work or chapter
draft.polishInstr: Polish this passage: keep plot and characters, smooth the prose, strengthen imagery, and do not add new plot.
draft.undoMismatch: Undo snapshot does not match this chapter and was discarded

{user}

outlineQ.needOpen: Open a work and select a chapter first

outlineQ.waitDraft: Wait for the current draft to finish or cancel before starting an outline run

continuity.mustNot: Do not rewrite meals, sleep, or travel from the previous chapter as if they have not happened; do not serve the same meal again; do not change established family ties (whose child, which cousin line).
continuity.writeHint: Carry over the previous chapter’s time, place, and character state. If they already ate or had watermelon, write after the meal — do not call people to dinner. Use kinship terms from the character cards.
continuity.oneLineHint: One-line outline: only advance the action already in that sentence; the last chapter must leave an unpaid core wish or next-beat hook. Do not pretend the book is finished.
